title: Baires Raffaelli – bibliographic, academic and authority control dataset
description: Linked Open Data (Schema.org + BIBFRAME 2.0) about the architect, researcher and author Baires Raffaelli: authority identifiers, the three Fast Guide books (BIS Publishers) and their translations, page-level citation evidence, events, projects, awards and library holdings. Formats: Turtle, JSON-LD, N-Triples, key-value text, CSV; SHACL shapes and SPARQL queries included.
